title: Akal Badi ya Bias: An Exploratory Study of Gender Bias in Hindi Language Technology

bias_targets.methodology: The study evaluates gender bias through a multi-pronged approach: 1) Heuristic and embedding-based retrieval from raw text corpora (LaBSE, CORGI), 2) Evaluating the transferability of translated bias datasets from English and Chinese to Hindi, 3) Training computational models (mBERT binary classifier and IndicBERT regression scorer) to automatically classify and score biased sentences, and 4) Conducting community-centered field studies where rural, low-income women annotate GPT-generated sentences using a Best-Worst Scaling (BWS) comparative annotation framework to determine degrees of gender bias.
